[[Eldin Sunstrider|Eldin]] (distant nephew) | affiliation= [[Quel'Thalas (kingdom)|Quel'Thalas]]|faffiliation=[[Alliance of Lordaeron]]}} '''Anasterian Sunstrider''' was the last [[High elf|high elven]] king of [[Quel'Thalas (kingdom)|Quel'Thalas]]. During the [[Second War]], he reluctantly joined the [[Alliance of Lordaeron]], duty-bound to fulfill a pledge of loyalty and friendship to the Arathi bloodline, of whom Sir [[Anduin Lothar]] was the last. Anasterian was forced to contribute more of Quel'Thalas' armies when the outer forests were attacked by the [[Old Horde|Horde]].[[The Alliance of Lordaeron]] Following the war, he withdrew his nation from the Alliance, stating that the humans' poor leadership had led to the burning of the elves' forests during the Second War.[[The Alliance Splinters]] Still reigning over Quel'Thalas at the time of its fall, Anasterian died along with the [[Convocation of Silvermoon]]. ==Notes and trivia== * An epic one-handed sword, [[Anasterian's Legacy]], drops from [[Moroes]] in [[Lower Karazhan Halls]]. * [[Anasterian Park]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]] is named in his honor. ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Sunstrider, Anasterian}} [[Category:High elf characters]] [[Category:Aristocrats]] [[Category:Deceased characters]] [[Category:Lore characters]]
